title: Concept: Basic authentication challenge sent over plaintext HTTP
description: A Basic challenge was observed on an http response. Base64 is an encoding, not encryption, so the password travels in a form any intermediary can read. The protection that would make Basic acceptable is transport encryption, and this response does not have it.
applicability: HTTP responses that issue an authentication challenge to a browser or API client.
risk: Reusable credentials readable in transit; MEDIUM severity.
